scoring: Each of 5 outcome conditions earns 1/5; all conditions and numeric tolerances are listed in README.md and scene.json. Full score requires all conditions, all task bodies at <=0.01 m/s and <=0.2 rad/s, conservative robot clearance >=0.02 m for one continuous second. Before the hold completes, credit is capped at 0.95. Any lost part, fixture displacement, violated preservation invariant or penetration above 0.002 m permanently scores zero.
run_limit: 3600 controls at 20 Hz (180 simulated seconds), provisional budget
reset_notes: Reset the native environment, restore every body and joint to scene.json, settle, then clear scorer history. Two independent full-score trials remain required.
fidelity: Engineering draft; unvalidated rigid primitives and passive joints. This generic kitting candidate fails the current novelty screen and is retained only as reusable scorer/scene code. Replace before submission. Arm-separated supply locations induce use of both workspaces but do not establish sustained bimanual coordination.
